definitions.explanation: Contributing to or playing a role in achieving something positive. A formal word for making a meaningful contribution to a cause, field, or outcome.

examples.japanese: {社会|しゃかい}に{寄与|きよ}する。
この{研究|けんきゅう}は{医学|いがく}の{発展|はってん}に{大|おお}きく{寄与|きよ}した。
examples.english: This research greatly contributed to the advancement of medicine.

examples.japanese: {地域|ちいき}{経済|けいざい}への{寄与|きよ}が{高|たか}く{評価|ひょうか}され、{表彰|ひょうしょう}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: His contribution to the local economy was highly evaluated, and he received an award.

notes:
{寄与|きよ} combines {寄|き} (to approach, to contribute) and {与|よ} (to give). It is a formal word used in written and official contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {社会|しゃかい}に{寄与|きよ}する (to contribute to society)
- {発展|はってん}に{寄与|きよ}する (to contribute to development)
- {寄与|きよ}{度|ど} (degree of contribution)
- {寄与|きよ}が{大|おお}きい (significant contribution)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {寄与|きよ} vs. {貢献|こうけん}: Both mean "contribution," but {寄与|きよ} is more formal and literary. {貢献|こうけん} is the more common, everyday word. {寄与|きよ} often appears in academic, legal, and official writing.
